summary.text: Shannon Brennan is the Republican candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where incumbent Liz Storer (D) is also on the ballot.
Brennan is an energy consultant who advanced from the August 18, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Shannon Brennan said in a Ballotpedia survey that she has had a 35-year career in energy research and development and public service and owns Shannon A. Brennan & Associates LLC, an energy management consulting firm.
She said she holds Stanford certifications in advanced project management and energy innovation and is a Senior Fellow with the Partnership for Public Service.
Brennan said she serves or has served on the Teton District Board of Health, the St. John's Health Board and the Wyoming Governor's Groundwater Advisory Committee.
In the survey, Brennan described herself as a conservative and said she stands for fiscal responsibility, limited government, lower taxes and protection of public lands and private land rights.

She said she supports zero-based budgeting, keeping the Mineral Severance Tax managed as a special corpus fund, expanding University of Wyoming extractive-industries programs, and preserving rural hospitals.
